# `aitbc reinvest policy`

Show or record a reinvestment policy for an agent.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc reinvest policy [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--agent-id` | text | — | yes | The Agent-id. |
| `--staking-pct` | text | `50` | no | Percentage directed to staking |
| `--reserve-pct` | text | `30` | no | Percentage kept in reserve |
| `--min-reinvest` | text | `1` | no | Minimum amount to reinvest |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc reinvest policy --agent-id <agent_id>
```
